subject: [PATCH v9 31/32] mm: install PMD swap entries on swap-out

2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch improves the handling of PMD-mapped anonymous huge pages (THPs) during swap-out operations. When a THP is swapped out, it currently splits into smaller mappings, which can lead to performance issues and increased memory usage. This patch introduces a new approach where a single PMD-level swap entry is created for each contiguous run of slots in the swap cache, eliminating the need for splitting and reducing the number of small mappings. The patch also updates various kernel components, including huge_memory.c, rmap.c, vmscan.c, and vmstat.c, to support this new approach.
